question: How was the LORD's command about the plunder of Ai different from His command about Jericho?
options: At Ai nothing could be touched
At Ai all the gold went to the priests
At Ai Israel could keep the plunder and livestock
At Ai everything had to be burned
explanation: At Jericho everything was devoted to the LORD, but at Ai the LORD allowed Israel to carry off the plunder and livestock for themselves.
